        <script><![CDATA[class TableMetadataHelper {
    /**

    constructor(table, desiredSampleSize = 100, timeoutThreshold = 5000) {

    /**
     * Retrieves the number of records available in the table with a max cap of the desired sample size.
     * @param {number} desiredSampleSize - The desired sample size to use when calculating the available record count.
     * @returns {number} The number of records available in the table.
     * @private
     */
    _getAvailableRecordCount(desiredSampleSize) {
        let maxSampleSize = desiredSampleSize;
        const startTime = new Date().getTime();
    
        try {
            let ga = new GlideAggregate(this.table);
            ga.setAggregateWindow(0, desiredSampleSize);
            ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
            ga.query();
    
            // We have to check timout manually because because GlideAggregate query() blocks the event loop to we can't use setTimeout
            const elapsedTime = new Date().getTime() - startTime;
            if (elapsedTime > this._timeoutThreshold) {
                this._timeoutTriggered = true;
                gs.warn(`Timeout triggered for table ${this.table} after ${elapsedTime}ms. Skipping next set of GlideAggregate queries for this table`);
                return 0;
            }
    
            if (ga.next()) {
                maxSampleSize = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            gs.error(`Error in _getAvailableRecordCount: ${error.message}`);
        }
    
        return maxSampleSize;
    }

    /**
     * Retrieves all fields of the table and their metadata.
     * @returns {Object} An object where each key is a field name and the value is an object containing metadata about the field.
     * @private
     */
    _getAllFields() {
        const allFields = {};
        const gr = new GlideRecord(this.table);
        gr.initialize();

        const elements = gr.getElements();
        elements.forEach(element => {
            const elementDescription = element.getED();
            const elementName = element.getName();

            allFields[elementName] = {
                label: element.getLabel(),
                type: elementDescription.getInternalType(),
                length: elementDescription.getLength(),
                mandatory: elementDescription.isMandatory(),

            };

            if (elementDescription.getInternalType() === 'reference') {
                allFields[elementName].referenceTable = elementDescription.getReference();
            }
        });
        return allFields;
    }

    /**
     * Calculates the percentage of records that have a value in the specified field.
     * @param {string} fieldName - The name of the field to calculate the populated percentage for.
     * @returns {number} The percentage of records that have a value in the specified field.
     */
    calculatePopulatedPercentage(fieldName) {
        if (!fieldName) {
            return 0;
        }
    
        // If timeout has already been triggered, skip the attempt and return 0
        if (this._timeoutTriggered) {
            return 0;
        }
    
        // Exclude system field type percentage calculation to avoid security restrictions
        if (this.systemFieldNames.includes(fieldName)) {
            return 0;
        }
    
        let result = 0;
        const startTime = new Date().getTime();
    
        try {
            let ga = new GlideAggregate(this.table);
            ga.setAggregateWindow(0, this.sampleSize);
            ga.addNotNullQuery(fieldName);
            ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
            ga.query();
    
            // We have to check timout manually because because GlideAggregate query() blocks the event loop to we can't use setTimeout
            const elapsedTime = new Date().getTime() - startTime;
            if (elapsedTime > this._timeoutThreshold) {
                this._timeoutTriggered = true;
                gs.warn(`Timeout triggered for table ${this.table} and field ${fieldName} after ${elapsedTime}ms. Skipping next set of GlideAggregate queries for this table.`);
                return 0;
            }
    
            if (ga.next()) {
                let count = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
                result = (count / this.sampleSize) * 100;
            }
        } catch (error) {
            gs.error(`Error in calculatePopulatedPercentage: ${error.message}`);
        }
    
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * Retrieves a subset of fields based on the provided field names.
     * @param {Array<string>} fieldNames - An array of field names to retrieve metadata for.
     * @returns {Object} An object containing metadata for the specified fields.
     */
    getSubsetOfFields(fieldNames) {
        return fieldNames.reduce((acc, fieldName) => {
            if (this.fields[fieldName]) {
                acc[fieldName] = this.fields[fieldName];
            }
            return acc;
        }, {});
    }

    /**
     * Retrieves a subset of fields based on the provided field types.
     * @param {Array<string>} fieldTypes - An array of field types to retrieve metadata for.
     * @returns {Object} An object containing metadata for the fields with the specified types
     */
    getSubsetOfFieldsByTypes(fieldTypes) {
        return fieldTypes.reduce((acc, fieldType) => {
            for (const fieldName in this.fields) {
                if (this.fields[fieldName].type === fieldType) {
                    acc[fieldName] = this.fields[fieldName];
                }
            }
            return acc;
        }, {});
    }

    /**
     * Retrieves the label of a field based on its name.
     * @param {string} fieldName - The name of the field to retrieve the label for.
     * @returns {string} The label of the specified
     */
    getFieldLabelByName(fieldName) {
        return this.fields[fieldName] ? this.fields[fieldName].label : null;
    }
}

module.exports = TableMetadataHelper;]]></script>
